Compliance · Workflow automation

Compliance Certification

We built a workflow that turns a Jira request and supporting documents into a certification package a reviewer can check.

evoke

The problem

The same value can appear in different places in a document. We needed to show that a match came from the right field, table or regulatory reference before it could support a certification decision.

The decision

We used code for repeatable steps such as preparing the Jira request and finding the case folder. We used AI where the document needed interpretation, such as distinguishing reports from regulatory evidence or reading a value in context.

What we built

The output brings together the selected report, field comparisons and checks against regulator documents. When several documents match, the workflow pauses for a person to make the selection.
